'''Farstone''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Farstone system/Legends|Farstone system]] of the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected Farstone to the [[Umthyg system/Legends|Umthyg system]].<ref name="TEA" />

Featuring soaring [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] ranges, Farstone was sparsely populated and was at one point a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Colonist/Legends|colony]], but was eventually abandoned, although nominally remaining under the control of the [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Ancient Houses]] of the Senex-Juvex.<ref name="TEA" /> By [[43 ABY]],<ref name="date">The main section of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which includes a description of Farstone, ends with a mention of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]]'s journey across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the beginning of which is depicted in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''. The events of that novel are dated to [[43 ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> the world was mostly inhabited by [[Refugee/Legends|fugitives]], [[Hermit/Legends|hermits]], and [[Psychopathy|sociopaths]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Farstone was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] and which placed the world in grid square K-18.<ref name="TEA" />
